question: Does short-term reversal have an information coefficient on the SEC equity panel that survives costs, a liquidity screen, and a bid-ask-bounce control?
why_this_thread: Step 249 found that a negative short-horizon IC survived on roll-free ETF data at -0.020 after rolls explained about forty percent of the futures reading. Reversal is a different signal family from everything in the registry, and it is fast: Step 247 measured a 4-week signal delivering 3.6 times the breadth of a 52-week one. The attraction is breadth from signal speed, not novelty. Reversal is a documented anomaly and finding it would be a sanity check, not a discovery.
data_provenance: broad_full_history_panel_v1 (2011-2026, 2824 issuers) put through build_corporate_action_clean_prices_v1: 14 issuers quarantined, 11,798 sub-dollar cells removed, worst weekly return 25,733% to 1,873%
signal: minus the compounded return over the lookback, ranked cross-sectionally each week

controls_that_must_pass.bid_ask_bounce: skip_weeks = 1 removes the week adjacent to the signal. A price series recorded at alternating bid and ask produces mechanical negative autocorrelation at lag one that no one can trade. If the IC exists at skip 0 and vanishes at skip 1, it was bounce and the result is rejected.
controls_that_must_pass.liquidity: IC measured within price quintiles. Price level is a weak proxy for liquidity and is stated as such, but reversal concentrating in the cheapest quintile is the documented failure mode and must be visible.
controls_that_must_pass.cost: 0, 10, 50, 100 and 200 bps on a breadth-100 long-only book. Reversal is the most turnover-hungry family there is and this is where it usually dies.
controls_that_must_pass.breadth: measured the same way as Steps 245 to 247 so the numbers are comparable
controls_that_must_pass.correlation: against the existing strategy paths; the entire purpose is breadth, so a reversal book correlated with what is already held is worthless even if profitable

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_ic_vanishes_at_skip_1: it was bid-ask bounce; reject and record
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_ic_exists_only_in_the_cheapest_price_: not tradeable at size; reject and record
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_the_book_loses_money_at_50bps: reject; a reversal strategy that needs sub-50bps execution is not available to this owner
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_it_survives_all_three_and_correlates_: it adds no breadth and is not worth pursuing regardless of its return
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_it_survives_all_three_and_is_uncorrel: a genuine candidate, and the first breadth increase this project would have found; it still enters at the bottom of the gate list with no forward evidence

cumulative_trial_warning: These 18 stack on every configuration searched in this project across 249 recorded steps. Nothing here may be reported without saying so.
